review: Independent read-only native fixture and registration source review
fixture_state: Uncommitted working-tree files reviewed by exact SHA-256; no native execution performed by this reviewer.
verdict: No outstanding source-level fixture or registration blocker within the stated bounded scope. The two initial review findings were addressed: adequate settling before exact moved-target checks, and explicit combined-output audibility scope.
scope: Main 128 paired scenarios by static loop inspection: Legacy/Circuit, 8/16 voices, 0/32 callback frames, lower/upper members 2/15, pedal/no pedal, Note Off/zero-velocity Note On, same/separate offsets.
Eight before-release ordering scenarios and eight held-primary/released-extension composition scenarios by static loop inspection.

Actual processBlock dispatch, finite exact-bit continuation comparison against a no-later-event reference, original voice identity and intended engine checks, later cache-initialized onset and explicit CC121 tail reset.
Corresponding native CMake test registration and ui_snapshot command-line dispatch.
Delta against the preserved initial fixture, unchanged frozen production hashes and corrected accepted-engine-gate plan wording.

resolved_findings.issue: Two Circuit moved-timbre cases required final target bits after only 256 host frames, while the 5 ms smoother would still be moving.
resolved_findings.resolution: Both now render 6144 host frames at 48000 Hz (128 ms) before exact final-target assertions. At 25.6 time constants the declared one-pole residual is below its 1e-9 snap threshold. The main unchanged-tail paired continuation remains short.
resolved_findings.verification: Source/delta review only; runtime success not claimed.

resolved_findings.issue: Sixteen-voice non-silence checks could be satisfied by held primary filler notes without proving extension audibility.
resolved_findings.resolution: Labels explicitly state non-silent combined processor output. Evidence must distinguish a single-voice audible witness in eight-voice mode from combined output plus exact intended-extension state in sixteen-voice mode.
resolved_findings.remaining_limit: This fixture does not isolate the extension audio contribution.

positive_observations: The intended target Engine is selected explicitly, its current member role is checked, and eight held primary notes force extension allocation in sixteen-voice cases.

The original voice slot is checked for active/released state, note and channel after expression events and again after the later onset before CC121 assertions. A reclaimed slot containing the later different note cannot silently pass.
All audio equality comparisons require finite floats and exact bits. Main cases compare only before the fresh-note divergence; subsequent state checks deliberately disable audio comparison.
Zero-frame events preserve ordering while offsets clamp to the same boundary; only the 32-frame separated cases claim elapsed time.
CC74 timbre is checked independently through both rank offsets; cached bend and pressure through exact target telemetry.
The native test entrypoint returns failure when checks fail and the CMake registration uses the same command-line selector.
Production Engine.cpp and Engine.h hashes still match the frozen source review.
limits: This report is source review, not a native pass or permission to execute the test.
